details.caption:
VIRAL CRISPY PASTA SALAD 🥗 

CRISPY PASTA: 
150g pasta shells
Drizzle of olive oil
¼ cup freshly grated parmesan

Cook pasta in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Drain, toss with olive oil and parm, then air fry at 390°F for 10–12 minutes, tossing halfway, until golden and crispy.

YOGURT DRESSING:
½ cup plain yogurt
1 tbsp honey Dijon mustard
1/2-1 tbsp white balsamic vinegar, to taste
salt, to taste

Whisk everything together and adjust to taste.

THE VEG:
2 cups (½ head) romaine, finely diced
½ English cucumber, finely diced
1 cup cherry tomatoes, diced
¼ cup Kalamata olives
⅛ cup pepperoncini, diced

TO ASSEMBLE:

Add the veg and dressing to a bowl, toss in the crispy pasta and enjoy! All ingredients to taste. Serve immediately for max crunch. Note 🗒️ I actually like this salad wayyyy more without air frying the pasta lol 😂 so if you want to save yourself a step, it’s worth it. 

#crunchypastasalad #viraltrend
